FAQs
How to find the right monday.com partner for your business?

The monday.com go-to Partners Marketplace with AI-powered matching can help. Or, you can browse certified partners by services, industry, location, and language. Get matched through a quick questionnaire that builds your Live Brief automatically.
Can monday Platinum partners help with data migration from the current system?

Yes, certified Platinum partners like Fruition provide expert help with workflow design, data migration, process building, overall setup, integrations, and team training. This ensures seamless transitions without data loss.
How do we verify a partner's expertise before engaging them?

All partners listed in monday.com have detailed public profiles that highlight their expertise, certifications, and verified customer reviews. Go through them before choosing. Usually, monday partners are certified and rated by real customers for transparency.
